tha-ap175:1.1: Rattipupphiya.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ araññe kānane ahaṃ / Vipassiṃ addasam Buddhaṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ. // //
tha-ap175:2.1: Rattikaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā kuṭajaṃ dharaṇīruhaṃ / samūlaṃ paggahetvāna upanesiṃ mahe*sino. // //
tha-ap175:3.1: Ekanavute* ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap175:4.1: Ito ca aṭṭhame kappe Suppasannassanāmako / sattaratanasampanno rājāhosi mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap175:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Rattipupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
